prompt: A user owns eight repositories and keeps pasting the same bug-report template into each one. What is the least-effort fix?
explanation: A repository named `.github` under your account supplies default community health files — issue templates, pull request template, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, and more — to all your repositories unless a repository overrides them with its own.

options.text: Create a `.github` repository — its default community health files apply to every repository they own
Turn every repository into a template
Pin the template as a starred gist
